messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — planning a short "build blitz" tonight before cutoff. Need final version bumps, changelog approvals, and a quick flaky test triage. ETA window 21:00–22:30 PT. Who can join for a fast sweep?
priya: I can handle changelog reviews and tag the entries. dropping my PR links in a sec.
lin: I’ll run a quick CI pass on release/v2.4 and look at failing tests. Ping me for reruns.
omar: I can help triage the flaky tests that fail on macos/ci. I’ll try to reproduce locally.
kai: I’ll coordinate branch gating and make sure no new merges slip in during the window. Please stop merging into main after 20:30 PT. :lock:
morgan: @priya thanks — can you call out any lingering breaking changes?
priya: nothing breaking. only version bumps: server 2.4.1 -> 2.4.2, sdk-js 1.9.0 -> 1.9.1. I’ll post the PR ids: https://git.internal/r/redwood/server/pulls/4221 and https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk-js/pulls/314
lin: CI run on release/v2.4 started. If we see flakes, let’s quarantine with @flaky tag and open a follow-up issue.
ci-bot: [ci-bot] Build queued for branch release/v2.4 (sha: a1b2c3d). Status: queued -> running
priya: changelog PRs are approved from my side. I pushed a tiny formatting fix.
omar: Found two recurring flakes in unit-tests/auth.test and integration/latency.test that fail intermittently. Assigning owners: @lin for auth.test, @omar for latency.test.
lin: I’ll try to reproduce auth.test locally. If I can, I’ll post a minimal repro and a flaky marker.
ci-bot: [ci-bot] Build failed: macos/integration (flake). Test: integration/latency.test. Re-run suggestion: `/ci retry a1b2c3d`
morgan: For reruns use this helper:```bash
# rerun CI for a commit
./scripts/ci/retry.sh a1b2c3d
```
priya: tagging the changelog as finalized in the release PRs.
kai: Putting release/v2.4 into a gated state now. No merges until we have two consecutive green runs.
lin: Reproduced auth.test flake — appears to be a race around token cache warmup. I’ll open a small fix and a test guard.
omar: latency.test looks like a timing-sensitive integration. For the sweep, I propose we skip on macos with @flake-ignore and add a ticket to harden. Owner: @omar -> ISSUE-789
morgan: Sounds good. Quick list of actions before cutoff:
- priya: finalize changelog + bump versions (done)
- lin: submit flaky guard for auth.test (in progress)
- omar: add skip for latency.test on macos + create ISSUE-789
- kai: gate the branch and hold merges
- everyone: respond to CI failures within 10m during window

If anyone sees a new red that looks product-impacting, call it out and we’ll rollback.
priya: all set on my end. pushed tags and bumped package.json.
ci-bot: [ci-bot] Build queued: rerun for a1b2c3d -> running -> success
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Release candidate artifacts published for v2.4.2-rc1
morgan: Excellent. If we stay green for one more run, I’ll cut the release. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :tada:
kai: Leaving the gate in place until 22:30 PT, then will open if two greens.
lin: PR for auth.test guard opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/server/pulls/4233
omar: Added skip + ISSUE-789: https://git.internal/r/redwood/issues/789
priya: tagging release notes as ready.
morgan: Closing the loop — we’ll reconvene in #eng-releases if anything blows up. Otherwise, assume release proceeds after the second green. Great job.
